discovery: Unmodified ASR24 original-grid/static-world fixture ranking: >=500 WU^2, <=256 eligible fixtures, 384 WU radius, 30 degrees, colour cosine >=0.85, fixed 4 WU stand-off; dynamic-map refusal retained
fit: ASR24 local128/common-normals/receiver-path; first three ranked candidates having >=3 records; one to three permitted; unchanged admission, fitting, validation, held-out and frozen-removal gates

independent_rois.selection: Original world planar surface vertex centroids + 4 WU signed normal; minimum SHA256(map hash/surface ordinal) seed, then farthest-point sampling with hash tie break; no fixtures, grid RGB, luxel RGB or fit scores

coverage: Per-ROI observation counts are independent of discovery; accepted-source support counts unique original fitting sample IDs only in accepted ROIs. Neither is source recall or whole-map readiness. ROI overlap is not summed as unique coverage.
